goal: P32 as stated in frozen Foundations 1.0.0 section 33
active_obligation: Construct the leading singular subspace and derive its residual norm from the actual ordered singular values, then supply perturbation bounds.
convention: Real finite-dimensional inner-product spaces; singular values indexed from zero and padded by zero.
route: Right Gram spectral expansion, finite coordinate subspaces and orthogonal projections. Dimension comparison for perturbation.
proof_criterion: Lean-checked statements with constructed subspaces and no assumed spectral tail or spectral perturbation conclusions.
remaining_basis_obligation: Explicit orthonormal-basis cross-matrix decoder and its minimum-singular-value bound.
counterchecks: Zero rank, full rank, rectangular domain and codomain, repeated singular values; reject strictly smaller residual constants on concrete maps.
scope: P32 remains partial unless all named manuscript implications are actually established.
